name: REFINER_FAILURE
exact_rule: dedicated refiner does not create enough positive action opportunity

name: ROUTER_FAILURE
exact_rule: learned paired gain fails to outperform simple GT-free routing signals out of sample
metric: OOF router AUC/benefit vs simple proxies

name: PRESERVATION_FAILURE
exact_rule: routed system materially degrades the global reference

name: RESOURCE_FAILURE
exact_rule: router/refiner cost removes the useful compute-performance trade-off

name: DOMAIN_COLLAPSE
exact_rule: benefit is concentrated in one domain while another is materially harmed

name: H1_SUPPORTED
exact_rule: learned pre-execution GT-free predictor beats simple proxies at equal budget
metric: OOF router vs proxies at equal budget

name: PRESERVATION_SATISFIED
exact_rule: lower bound of Delta > -0.005 on macro-domain Dice and no domain collapse

name: FRONTIER_MEASURED
exact_rule: a measurable accuracy-compute frontier exists across budget points
rationale: frontier measured in Phase25E; Phase25G re-reports
